summary: BIT ORIGIN Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting results of an extraordinary general meeting held on August 11, 2026. Shareholders approved a name change to SANGRIX INC., a share capital increase from US$15,000 to US$60,000,000 with 950 billion Class A and 50 billion Class B shares, adoption of an amended memorandum, and a 5-for-1 share consolidation effective August 21, 2026. The meeting had quorum with 42.18% voting power. No special-situation transaction is involved; these are routine corporate governance changes, so no deal terms or strategic event apply.
